controls.title: Accuracy checks
controls.statement: For critical data entered manually, there should be an additional check on the accuracy of the data. This check may be done by a second operator or by validated electronic means.

controls.title: Data storage protection
controls.statement: Data should be secured by both physical and electronic means against damage. Stored data should be checked for accessibility, readability and accuracy.

controls.title: Audit trail
controls.statement: Consideration should be given to building into the system the creation of a record of all GMP-relevant changes and deletions (a system generated audit trail).

controls.title: Access control
controls.statement: Physical and/or logical controls should be in place to restrict access to computerised systems to authorised persons.

controls.title: Change and configuration management
controls.statement: Any changes to a computerised system including system configurations should only be made in a controlled manner in accordance with a defined procedure.

controls.title: Periodic evaluation
controls.statement: Computerised systems should be periodically evaluated to confirm that they remain in a valid state and are compliant with GMP.
